title: Time-Travelling Clock (Roman Numerals)
hints: Make a table of (value, symbol) pairs from largest to smallest INCLUDING the subtractive ones: 900 CM, 400 CD, 90 XC, 40 XL, 9 IX, 4 IV.
to_roman: for each entry, while n >= value, append the symbol and subtract the value.
from_roman: scan left to right; if a symbol's value is smaller than the next symbol's value, subtract it, otherwise add it.
